parsed.post: Discarding the attempt to increase MATRIX_LR for DEPTH 8. It regressed from 0.9836 to 1.0166. The higher learning rate seems to destabilize the deeper model. Reverting to my best (0.9836) and testing a higher ASPECT_RATIO of 64 to see if wider capacity helps.
parsed.description: Increasing ASPECT_RATIO from 48 to 64 on DEPTH 8 to increase model width and capacity, while reverting MATRIX_LR to 0.05.
